title: AI Kitchen Design — Redesign Your Kitchen From a Photo
excerpt: Upload a photo of your kitchen and see it redesigned in 18 styles in about 30 seconds. Refresh, remodel, or fully redesign with AI. Your first design is free.

Three steps

How AI kitchen design works.

  1. 01

    Upload a photo

    A clear, wide shot of your kitchen from a corner or doorway. JPG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF, straight from your phone.

  2. 02

    Pick a style and how much to change

    Choose from 18 styles, then Refresh, Remodel, or Redesign. Add colors, materials, or an inspiration photo.

  3. 03

    Compare, refine, download

    Slide between before and after, ask for tweaks like “make the island navy”, and download in 2K or 4K.

The basics

What is AI kitchen design?

AI kitchen design uses an image model to redraw a photo of your kitchen with new cabinets, countertops, backsplash, flooring, and lighting. The walls, windows, doors, and camera angle stay where they are, so the result is your room in a new finish and not a stock render.

It answers the question a showroom can't: what will this look like in my kitchen, in my light? It does not replace measuring. The images are concepts, small details can change, and nothing is to scale, so pair them with the free kitchen planner for real dimensions. Read how to design your kitchen with AI for a step-by-step guide.

Not just kitchens

Use the same credits to redesign any room.

Plan with confidence

Use AI concepts to plan your next steps.

AI concepts can change small details and aren't to scale. Always confirm measurements and construction with a professional.
